heading: Exact plot origin and scale
help: Coordinates are (source value - origin) / scale. Origin and scale are exact values in the declared source unit; scale must be positive. This changes display coordinates, not the retained measurements or their units.
numericX: Horizontal origin and scale require a numeric horizontal column. Choose Numeric or turn off this horizontal transform.
reduction: Summaries are calculated from exact source values before this transform. Uncertainty widths are divided by the scale without subtracting the origin; observation counts stay unchanged.
invalid: Enter valid exact origins and positive scales with their number representations.
sourceValues: Exact source values remain in the retained dataset. Coordinate errors are measured in the original source units.
coordinateValues: These are projected coordinates. Use the retained point source to inspect exact measurements and projection errors.
points: Inspect plotted points and exact sources
error: Binary projection error in source units
resourcesHelp: These saved limits apply to exact parsing, reductions, comparisons and coordinate projection. Source and storage waits do not consume arithmetic time. Reaching a limit stops preparation; it does not change the measurements.
resourcesNotes: Approximation remains a separate choice below. Retained source values and earlier figures keep their original interpretation.
revisedSettings: These settings come from the stopped calculation. Saving creates a separate calculation; the stopped job and earlier results stay unchanged.
